name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native workflow that reserves high-value judgment for Sol and delegates decision-complete bounded execution to Luna V2.

interface.shortDescription: Sol owns critical judgment; native Luna V2 executes decision-complete bounded work.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor routes every request by default. Sol primary keeps intent, architecture/contracts, authorization, risk, option selection, integration, and acceptance; one native Luna V2 role on gpt-5.6-luna at max effort receives an exact bounded evidence question or a decision-complete coherent repository write phase. Atomic one-file micro-edits may stay primary only when the strict micro-edit boundary holds; multi-file and cross-repository phases go to a worker. Browser/runtime QA uses the durable $chrome:control-chrome route unless the user explicitly selects another tool, while app-task Luna and legacy Terra/Sol remain explicit compatibility options.
defaultPrompt: Route through Sol Advisor; keep high-value judgment in Sol and delegate decision-complete execution to Luna Max.
Use app-task Luna or legacy Terra/Sol only when I explicitly authorize compatibility.
